name: Banh tet
summary: Bánh tét is one of the products the Tiền Giang tourism portal lists for the Mỹ Phong noodle village, with bánh ít, hủ tiếu, bánh hỏi, and bánh tầm. A filling was not printed.
origin: Phường Mỹ Phong. The Tiền Giang tourism portal lists it among the village products.
howToEat: The tourism portal names bánh tét as a village product and prints no serving.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. A serving hour was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The village sits at ấp Hội Gia and ấp Mỹ Hòa, phường Mỹ Phong, and in old phường 9. The Đồng Tháp tourism portal prints the Hội Gia workshop as 07:00–18:00. That clock is the visit, not a cake stall.
